acceptance: 1) Through HTTP with a valid signed-consent cookie, separately send page_view/product_view/model_view_start/model_load_success/model_load_failure/chat_start. Assert required navigationId/viewId/productSlug, the published-product allowlist and strict length boundaries individually. Reject forged/unpublished products, unknown kinds, oversized fields and full URLs with sensitive query parameters; rejected events do not increase the row count. Rate-limit the 121st event per cookie per minute or the 301st event per IP-HMAC per minute under section 10, returning 429 with Retry-After and persisting no rejected events. Query raw-event fields to verify no raw IP, cross-site fingerprint, email, chat body or sensitive full URL is stored (E-47). 2) PostgreSQL stores only one row for repeated eventId/semanticKey with the same payload and returns 409 for differing payloads. The same viewId has only one success/failure terminal; product-page events and start/terminal records are stored separately, and failure does not write success. Reject timestamps outside -48h/+5min. 3) After consent-cookie withdrawal, requests return 403 and event-row count does not change. M2-T7 wires the client model producer; M5-T7 wires browser consent and ordinary-page producers.

E-47.scene: C-05 Analytics collection, deduplication and retention
E-47.trigger: The client forges a product, sends oversized fields or arbitrary event kinds, or replays events
E-47.expect: The server validates allowlists, field lengths and product validity, limits abusive submission and rejects abnormal records. Analytics records must not store raw IP, cross-site fingerprints, email, chat body text or full URLs containing sensitive query parameters.
